column1: It's the middle of the night
You can pick it up or let it go to the machine
The best of intentions never win out
There's no way to make it pretty.
Goodness belongs to those hard working dogs.
That can run down their fear without pity
Dark eyes call out from between the bedsheets
Keep in mind  there's no denyin'.
Grind me down and fill up your cup.
Take me when you are weak.
Hard workin' dogs know their master is love
They lay down by love's side when it speaks
